purpose: Phase 12G representative demo playtest copy; describes visible goals and taught rules without embedding authored solution commands.

DEMO01.title: Demo 1 — The Official Road
DEMO01.brief: The courier needs a route from home to the office. Change the official map, then watch the derived world react to that map fact.

requirements.DEMO01_OBJ_COURIER_OFFICE: Courier must be able to reach the office.

DEMO02.title: Demo 2 — Wrong Turn
DEMO02.brief: One road can help one journey and create another. Keep the courier able to reach the depot while preventing livestock from reaching the pasture.

requirements.DEMO02_INV_COURIER_DEPOT: Courier must remain able to reach the depot.
requirements.DEMO02_OBJ_LIVESTOCK_BLOCK: Livestock must not be able to reach the pasture.

DEMO03.title: Demo 3 — Across the Canal
DEMO03.brief: The courier needs to reach the workshop across a static canal. The official map controls whether the authored crossing is usable.

requirements.DEMO03_OBJ_COURIER_WORKSHOP: Courier must be able to reach the workshop.

DEMO04.title: Demo 4 — Helpful to Whom?
DEMO04.brief: The same connectivity can serve different agents differently. Get the courier to the clinic while keeping livestock away from the pasture.

requirements.DEMO04_INV_LIVESTOCK_PASTURE: Livestock must not be able to reach the pasture.
requirements.DEMO04_OBJ_COURIER_CLINIC: Courier must be able to reach the clinic.

DEMO05.title: Demo 5 — A Line That Is Not a Wall
DEMO05.brief: The resident may travel only where East jurisdiction permits. Make the resident's clinic trip legal while preserving the courier's route; the border changes authority, not physical road geometry.

requirements.DEMO05_INV_COURIER_CLINIC: Courier must remain able to reach the clinic.
requirements.DEMO05_OBJ_RESIDENT_CLINIC: Resident must have a legal permission-compliant route to the clinic.
